## Last analysis
The big gain came from fixing the mirrored action layout. Cutting PPO epochs from 4 to 2, so the same budget buys more samples, added about 13 points. One epoch failed: the policy was under-fitted and one seed came out at 0.08. Within the 2-epoch recipe, both stronger optimisation changes helped by about 5 points over 0.877. Doubling the minibatches scored 0.933 with very consistent seeds; lr 0.002 scored 0.929. Learning curves were still rising at the end, so learning speed per sample is the bottleneck. The architecture changes either cost samples (two-stage head) or were unstable (stem skip: 0.92 and 0.32). Adding layers would cut samples, so this last round puts the trials into faster learning on the best network. Two candidates combine 64 minibatches with a larger lr (moderate and bold). The third keeps 64-sample minibatches but halves n_envs, which gives fresher rollouts and twice as many updates.
